```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).qemu.$(vmid).agent["file-read"].$get()
```

Reads the given file via guest agent. Is limited to 16777216 bytes.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  | Number of bytes to read. — min 1, max 16777216, default `"16777216"` |
| `decode` | boolean |  | Data received from the QEMU Guest-Agent is base64 encoded. If this is set to true, the data is decoded. Otherwise the content is forwarded with base64 encoding. Defaults to true. — default `1` |
| `file` | string | yes | The path to the file |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `offset` | number |  | Offset to start reading at — min 0, default `0` |
| `vmid` | number | yes | The (unique) ID of the VM. — format `pve-vmid`, min 100, max 999999999 |
